title: 第一卷 第8章 那些畜生，已经全杀了！
content_zh:
陈昭宁忽然觉得，对方塞刀过来的手法，实在太过粗鲁。

    可这股粗鲁，却像是点燃了她心中积压的怒火，让她本能地重重点头！

    她眸中的恐惧，瞬间化作滔天杀气！

    扑通！

    扑通！

    陈渊的速度快到极致，先杀山羊胡男子，再斩三名官差，一切都发生在电光火石之间！

    直到他将陈昭宁拉起，那些尸体才重重轰砸落地。

    山羊胡带来的那些护卫，虽然被允许排队，但也都被呵斥不准围观，早已转过身去，没看见刚才发生的一幕。

    此刻有人听见动静，还在调笑，

    “哟呵，听这撞击声，力度不小啊。”

    “小心点啊喂，留点汤给我们啊，别喝干了。”

    许多人嘿嘿大笑，一脸的猥琐。

    也有人察觉不对劲，忍不住回头。

    下一瞬，他们瞳孔骤然收缩，无法相信所看到的一切。

    几个官差竟然全都倒在了血泊之中。

    与此同时，陈渊用一块布帛缠住手掌，避免打滑。

    随即用力拔出铁刺，身形如箭般冲了出去！

    唰！

    他猛地腾空跃起，双膝弯曲，狠狠砸在一名回头大汉的胸膛上！

    砰！

    一声巨响，他将人直接撞倒在地，手中铁刺，对着其心口疯狂连刺！

    一、两下、三下、四下······

    噗噗噗！！！

    鲜血飙射间，陈渊将那大汉的心口，捅成了马蜂窝！

    那大汉目眦欲裂，都没反应过来，就当场毙命！

    陈渊却如一头嗜血猛虎，再度扑向其余人！

    噗嗤！

    铁刺刺穿一人腰腹，在对方惊恐的目光中，他身形一闪，已跃至另一名冲来的大汉肩上，铁刺直插对方的眼睛！

    噗！

    铁刺贯穿眼睛，从起后脑刺出！

    “啊！！！”

    凄厉的惨叫响彻当场！

    余下众人终于反应过来，满脸恐惧，却还是持刀杀向陈渊！

    “这是……缚龙搏杀术？？？”

    “那不是·······传说中执剑人的搏杀技吗？”

    陈昭宁从震撼中回过神，便看见陈渊已是连斩五六人！

    他的打斗招式，与她曾经见过的一名执剑人一模一样！

    “对，干死他们！”

    陈昭宁醒悟过来，彻底爆发！

    先前的屈辱与怒火在眼中燃烧！

    她抡起长刀，猛地冲杀出去！

    怒火加持之下，她战力暴涨。

    剩余之人早已被陈渊吓破胆，根本无力抵抗，被她一刀一个接连斩杀。

    噗通！

    噗通！

    一具具尸体倒下，鲜血四溅！

    “啊啊啊啊！”
content_en:
Chen Zhaoning suddenly felt that the other party's method of thrusting the knife was too rude.

    But this rudeness seemed to ignite the pent-up anger in her heart, making her instinctively nod hard!

    The fear in her eyes instantly turned into overwhelming murderous intent!

    thump!

    thump!

    Chen Yuan's speed was extremely fast. He first killed the man with the goatee and then three officials. Everything happened in the blink of an eye!

    It wasn't until he pulled Chen Zhaoning up that the corpses hit the ground heavily.

    Although the guards brought by Goatee were allowed to line up, they were also scolded and not allowed to watch. They had already turned away and did not see the scene that just happened.

    At this moment, someone heard the noise and was still teasing,

    "Oh, listen to the impact, it's quite strong."

    "Be careful, hey, leave some soup for us, don't drink it all."

    Many people laughed and looked obscene.

    Some people noticed something was wrong and couldn't help but look back.

    The next moment, their pupils suddenly shrank, unable to believe what they saw.

    Several officials fell into a pool of blood.

    At the same time, Chen Yuan wrapped his palm with a piece of cloth to prevent it from slipping.

    Then he pulled out the iron thorn with force and rushed out like an arrow!

    Uh-huh!

    He suddenly jumped into the air, bent his knees, and hit the chest of a big man who turned around hard!

    Bang!

    With a loud noise, he knocked the person directly to the ground, and stabbed his heart with the iron thorn in his hand crazily!

    One, two, three, four...

    Puff puff puff! ! !

    As the blood spurted out, Chen Yuan stabbed the big man's heart into a hornet's nest!

    The big man's eyes were splitting, and he didn't even react, so he died on the spot!

    But Chen Yuan was like a bloodthirsty tiger, pounced on the others again!

    Poof!

    The iron thorn pierced a man's waist and abdomen. Under the horrified gaze of the other person, he dodged and jumped onto the shoulder of another charging man. The iron thorn pierced the opponent's eyes!

    puff!

    Iron thorns penetrated the eyes and stabbed out from the back of the head!

    "Ah!!!"

    The screams echoed throughout the place!

    The rest of the people finally reacted, their faces full of fear, but they still charged at Chen Yuan with knives!

    "This is... the dragon-binding fighting technique???"

    "Isn't that... the legendary fighting skill of the sword holder?"

    Chen Zhaoning recovered from the shock and saw that Chen Yuan had killed five or six people in a row!

    His fighting moves were exactly the same as a sword wielder she had seen before!

    "Yes, kill them!"

    Chen Zhaoning woke up and completely exploded!

    The previous humiliation and anger burned in his eyes!

    She picked up her long knife and rushed out!

    Fueled by anger, her combat power skyrocketed.

    The remaining people had been frightened by Chen Yuan and were unable to resist. She killed them one after another with her sword.

    Plop!

    Plop!

    Corpses fell one after another, blood splattered everywhere!

    "Ahhhhh!"
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 8 Those beasts have all been killed!
